title: career-ops employer registry
description: Two record types. A row (one line of boards/<ats>/<initial>.ndjson) points from an employer to its ATS board. A manifest (contributions/<id>.json) records who contributed a batch of rows, where they came from, and under which license. seeds/employers-validate.mjs enforces these rules and a few this schema cannot express: careers_url must equal the canonical URL built from ats, region, board and workday_host; careers_url is unique; rows are sorted by board; manifest.rows equals the number of rows that name it; country codes exist in ISO 3166-1.

ats.description: The ATS that hosts the board.

region.description: Greenhouse and Lever only: the region the board is hosted in.

board.description: The board id. Workday: tenant/wdN/site. Ashby and the Workday site keep their case; recruitee, breezy, bamboohr and pinpoint are lowercase.

careers_url.description: The canonical board URL, built from ats, region, board and workday_host. The registry's unique key.

name.description: The employer's name. No URL, email address, phone number or @handle.

website.description: The employer's registrable domain, without scheme, www or path (example.com).

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes. Stored; not used by the scanner yet.

tags.description: Reserved. The tag vocabulary is not defined yet, so no tag is accepted.

contribution.description: The id of the manifest in contributions/ that added this row.

added.description: The date the row was added (YYYY-MM-DD).

retired.description: Maintainers only. A retired row stays in the file, so the board cannot be added again, and tools skip it.

retired_reason.description: Why the row was retired. owner_request: the employer asked for its removal.

id.description: <YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>, the same as the file name without .json.

contributor.description: GitHub username of the account that opens the pull request, without @.

on_behalf_of.description: The organization the list comes from, when it is not the contributor's own.

signed_by.description: Who grants the license. For an organization, a founder or an officer with authority to do so.

rows.description: How many rows this contribution adds.

origin.description: How and where the list was obtained, in one sentence.

no_conflicting_contract.description: No contract stops this list from being redistributed.

personal_data.description: The contribution holds no personal data.

exclusive.description: The contribution is not exclusive to anyone.

also_permits.description: The contributor also allows the licensor to distribute the contribution under these licenses.

attribution.description: How the contribution is credited in CHANGELOG.md.

date.description: The contribution date (YYYY-MM-DD), the same as the date in the id.

source.description: Where a pointer came from: community, ats-directory, vc-portfolio, employer-list:<org>, or prior-mit:<owner>/<repo>@<commit>.
